title: Doctor reports a board that has left its profile
objective: Once a board declares a profile, leaving it is a finding that `intent doctor` names, with `intent wb init` as the remedy. The classes report from the day they ship and refuse nothing until the fleet has been converged and their reach has been measured.
body:
## Builder and judge

cc builds this package and claims `ST0092/09` in the same chain as `intent wp start ST0092/09`. vc judges it and claims nothing.

## What is built

- **Four classes**, each its own finding with its own remedy: a board that declares no profile; a seat whose name or role differs from its profile's; a seat its profile declares that is not registered; and an hv inbox view outside the mediator's pair.
- **Each names `intent wb init`** as the step that repairs it, with the dry run first.
- **They report and do not gate.** None of the four is actionable for the pre-commit gate when it ships.

## The blast radius comes first

A new guard is measured on the fleet, read-only, before it can refuse anyone's commit. On 2026-11-10 the first class alone would fire on all 32 live boards. vc runs the banked census (refs/bank/vc/st0092/census-boards.zsh) against a build that carries this package and records the count per class and per project. Whether any class gates after the sweep is hv's to say, with that table in front of hv.

## Rulings since this package was written, 2026-11-10

These are vc's rulings under the pen, made on ic's read of the dispatch rows and cc's read as builder, and written here once hv ratified the terms. Where one disagrees with the text above, it stands and the text above gives way.

Class 1 goes: a board that declares no profile is no finding. The other classes join `is_shown_by_default`, shown and never counted, so doctor exits 0 and the gate passes, with an arm for each. Class names are stable kebab-case identifiers listed in the row. Each finding names the profile it measured against, and its remedy is the dry run, then `--apply`.

## Rulings on the second row read, 2026-11-10

These are vc's rulings under the pen on ic's read of this package against the dispatch table at d6f56d7e6. Where one disagrees with anything above, the section before it included, it stands and the text above gives way.

The class ids are NOT listed in the dispatch row, which the section above said. A finding class's stable id has one home, `FindingClass::as_str`, and the three new classes get their ids there. If an agent is to see them from the guide, that is a render from the enum and never a hand-kept row field. No new row and no new flag.

## Depends on

WP-03 and WP-05.
